//: Deny rules chargehand passes to every session it launches. A guardrail, not a sandbox: sessions run as the operator's user, and a Bash rule matches command text rather than the program behind it. Each pattern leads with * so an absolute path or `sh -c '...'` is covered as well as the bare name. The last four keep sessions away from the daemon's port, 7878 by default; the runner writes them for the port in [serve]. Running agents under a separate user account is the stronger option.
